narr: Thunderstorms moved northeast across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. Heavy rain and flash flooding was observed west of Safford and a dust storm moved across southwest Pinal County.
ev: Heavy rain of 1.5 in less than 1 hour caused flash flooding in Pima, AZ. Highway 70 became flooded and impassable.
lsr: A SOCIAL MEDIA (TWITTER) POST FROM THE PUBLIC STATING ROADS ARE IMPASSABLE IN THE PIMA, AZ ALONG US 70.
